newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to announce first LMCS lincenses.
newsitem.headline: Canada to announce first LMCS lincenses.

text.p: Canadian Industry Minister John Manley will award the first licenses for the so-called local multipoint communications systems (LMCS) on Tuesday, Industry Canada said in a press release.

LMCS is a broadband wireless telecommunications service operating in the 28 gigahertz range, capable of providing wireless cable television, Internet access, video teleconferencing and other multimedia services.

"Homes and businesses will be sending and receiving signals through equipment consisting of a small unobtrusive book-sized antenna and associated electronics about the size of a television converter," Industry Canada said.
Some 14 Canadian companies have applied for LMCS licenses, including WIC Western International Communications Ltd's Cellular Vision Canada Ltd and Fonorola Inc
Manley is expected to announce the licenses at a 1630 EST/2130 GMT news conference.
